prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1338; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at a signalized intersection. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including requests for statements, settlement discussions, and scheduling, exclusively to this office and do not contact our client directly.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply, within fourteen days of receipt of this letter. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this file so that our correspondence can reference it accurately.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to the incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, recorded statements, adjuster notes, repair estimates, and any signal timing or traffic camera footage in your possession. Please ensure that the vehicles involved are not repaired, salvaged, or disposed of until both parties have had an opportunity to inspect them.
